qa_pair.question: The liberty-citations router maps every request to a menu leaf that carries a gate. How many leaves carry the gate yes-exact, the gate for anything published under the user's name? Answer with a number only.
According to the liberty-citations router, which prompt handles checking a quote that someone posted? Answer with the prompt id only.
Which template in the category liberty-citations declares the most variables? Answer with the prompt id only.
How many prompts in the category liberty-citations are plain prompts rather than templates? Answer with a number only.
The reference for the liberty toolkit's tools names a Whisper model to use when verifying the window of a video before quoting it. Which model? Answer with the model name only.
In the template for parody dabing subtitles, how many characters may one subtitle line hold at most? Answer with a number only.
In the template that submits to Stoky Svobodného přístavu, how many characters may the title of a comment have at most? Answer with a number only.

Fill the template that submits a post or comment to Stoky Svobodného přístavu, giving values only for kind and text. How many placeholders does the server report as not filled? Answer with a number only.

Two templates of the liberty-citations category publish a text under the user's name through Chrome, one to Stoky and one to the Facebook forum. Which variable names do both declare? Answer as a comma-separated list in alphabetical order.
Besides job_status, which tool of the liberty MCP server does the liberty-citations router name for the menu leaf "Setup > First corpus build"? Answer with the tool name only.
